# Cheese Pay

> Cheese Pay lets you hold money in USDC — a dollar-stable currency — and send
> directly to any local bank account in fiat. Protect your savings from fiat
> devaluation without losing the ability to transact locally the normal way.
> Built on Stellar and EVM. Available across Africa.

## The core problem Cheese Pay solves
Many African countries face high inflation and currency devaluation.
People who hold savings in fiat watch their money lose value daily. But switching
to dollars traditionally means losing the ability to do normal local transactions —
paying rent, sending money to family, paying vendors — which all happen via local
bank account numbers.

Cheese Pay solves both problems at once:
- Hold your money in USDC (a USD-pegged stablecoin) so it does not devalue
- Send directly to any local bank account in fiat, just like a normal transfer
- No crypto knowledge required. Recipients get fiat in their regular bank account.

## Who it is for
- People who want to protect savings from fiat devaluation
- Freelancers and remote workers earning in USD who need to spend locally
- Businesses that invoice in dollars but pay local suppliers in fiat
- Diaspora communities sending money home to local bank accounts
- Travellers who want to pay locally without currency friction

## Key features
- Send to any local bank account directly from a USDC balance
- Hold savings in USDC — stable, dollar-pegged, not subject to fiat inflation
- Username-based transfers as an optional alternative to account numbers
- QR code payments for merchants
- Earn yield on idle USDC balance
- Cheese Black tier — zero fees, metal card, dedicated relationship manager, invite only
- Cheese Gold tier — higher limits, 0% conversion fee on first transactions, priority support
- EVM wallet support with cUSD and cUSDC on Celo (gas fees sponsored by Cheese Pay)

## How it works
1. User deposits USDC into their Cheese wallet
2. To send money locally, they enter a bank account number and amount in fiat
3. Cheese converts and delivers fiat to the recipient's bank account instantly
4. The sender's balance remains in USDC for future use

## Get started
- https://cheesepay.xyz

## Built on
- Stellar blockchain for USDC payments and fiat settlement
- EVM / Celo for cUSDC with sponsored gas fees
